QA Summary - 2026-07-27

Status: Passed

Tester account: testergothru@gmail.com

Environment:

  • API base URL: https://app2-dev.panorra.com
  • Views API base URL: https://views.panorra.com/v2
  • FE source checked: C:\Users\Work\github-projects\panorra-pwa

Verdict

The new POST /posts/block route is working as expected for the tested real-data scenarios. It blocks and unblocks a non-owned public post, rejects unauthenticated access, rejects missing sid, returns 409 for an unknown post, prevents self-blocking, and rejects private posts with the required message: Blocking private posts is not allowed.

No coding bug was found in this scope. No tested scenario returned HTTP 500.

QA Summary - 2026-07-27

Status: Passed

Tester account: testergothru@gmail.com

Environment: https://app2-dev.panorra.com

Verdict

POST /collection-post/upload-thumbnail works with the tested live dev API scenarios. The endpoint rejects unauthenticated, missing-file, and invalid-extension requests, then accepts a valid 128-byte PNG and returns the generated thumbnail and storage path.

No coding bug was found in this scope. The first two attempts used malformed PNG fixtures and produced HTTP 500 decode errors; those client fixtures were invalid checksums, not product defects. The rerun used a valid PNG and returned HTTP 200. No HTTP 500 occurred with a valid request.

Copyable Retest Data / Regression

This is a mutation test. Use a dedicated dev QA post and always restore its original visibility and metadata in cleanup. Obtain secrets through authorized team configuration; do not add credentials or Access-Code values to this issue.

Variable Value
auth_url https://app2-dev.panorra.com
write_url https://app2-dev.panorra.com
read_url https://views.panorra.com/v2
access_code Authorized dev Access-Code (secret)
token Set from data.token in the login response
sid A tester-owned, published post slug

1. Authenticate and save token

POST {{auth_url}}/auth
Accept: application/json
Content-Type: application/json
Access-Code: {{access_code}}
{
  "email_username": "testergothru@gmail.com",
  "password": "[authorized dev credential]"
}

Expected: HTTP 200; save data.token as token.

2. Set only the controlled QA post to private

POST {{write_url}}/posts/edit-description
Accept: application/json
Authorization: {{token}}
Access-Code: {{access_code}}
stage: dev
role: user

Body type: form-data.

sid={{sid}}
description={{original_description}}
category_id={{original_category_id}}
visibility=private

Expected HTTP 200, data.messages: "Update Post Description Success".

3. Verify private view is forbidden

POST {{write_url}}/posts/view
Accept: application/json
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: {{token}}
Access-Code: {{access_code}}
stage: dev
role: user
ec: false
v: 0

Payload:

{
  "sid": "{{sid}}",
  "r": "u"
}

Expected HTTP 403:

{
  "statusCode": 403,
  "data": {
    "valid": false,
    "errors": { "message": "Viewing post not allowed for private visibility" }
  }
}

4. Mandatory cleanup

Call POST {{write_url}}/posts/edit-description again with the exact original description, category_id, and visibility=public. Then confirm the controlled post is public via the owner timeline endpoint. If restoration fails, stop and restore the QA post before further testing.

Developer Notes

No coding bug found. No tested response returned HTTP 500. The issue-comment acceptance—"Forbidden added view" for a private post—was validated with a real temporary private post and cleanup.
